highlights.title: Bigger chat boxes on a phone
highlights.line: The message and search boxes in an agent's chat and a project room are taller on a phone, so they are easy to tap.

highlights.title: Your phone says when your Mac is asleep
highlights.line: Through Kosmos Plus, a Mac that does not answer is shown as asleep or turned off, with what to do to wake it.

highlights.title: Offline is not the same as your Mac
highlights.line: A phone or computer with no internet is told it is offline, instead of being told your Mac is not answering.

highlights.title: Undo an org-chart import
highlights.line: After an import makes agents, Undo lists what it will remove, then removes only the agents that import made.

highlights.title: A refused sign-in check says so
highlights.line: In AI Models, when Check now finds a Claude sign-in refused, it says Kosmos checked it, not that a request failed.
